scope: Bounded read-only design review only. No candidate, implementation, model, RPC, optimizer, checkpoint or benchmark. This is not a replacement method plan or an additional production requirement.
decision: A bounded default-inert layout extension of the existing owners is structurally feasible. It requires real lease/runner/finite-FA ABI and indexing extensions; it is not available through current configuration. The existing DT finite formulas, true B4 native execution and original FA/FLA mathematical operators can remain unchanged. No numerical or speed pass is claimed.

canonical_HF_owner.patch_scope: Exact previously tested minimal HF cached-convolution API patch; installed canonical module, no eager sitecustomize import in environment children

layout.symbols: For row i, p_i is its unchanged factual 64-aligned prefix cut; s_i is its valid suffix length; P=max(p_i), S=max(s_i), K=max(p_i+s_i). Preserve interleaved endpoint pairs and one true B4 contrast batch.
layout.native_cache: Use original HF DynamicCache composition/update ownership. Stack each row own factual GDN conv/recurrent state. FA prefix KV rows are right-padded to P; native append adds rectangular suffix of S. The full FA validity mask is [p_i valid prefix, P-p_i holes, s_i valid suffix, S-s_i right pad]. Do not implement a second cache transition.
layout.native_model: Pass original accepted mask mapping: full_attention gets the full KV mask, linear_attention gets the local suffix right-pad mask. Pass explicit per-row position_ids=p_i+local_index. Existing native model at1197/1206/1228 already accepts these representations; avoid copying the native causal/recurrent mask helpers.
layout.native_FA: The original HF mask path unpads KV holes and right-padded Q using the last S mask positions. Its logical K length is p_i+s_i, logical Q length is s_i, so original bottom-right causal offset is Kvalid-Qvalid=p_i. Thus local query j sees precisely original logical keys <=p_i+j. Cached key RoPE remains original; suffix RoPE uses original per-row logical position.
layout.native_GDN: Keep original dense B4 FLA with cu_seqlens=None and each row own initial conv/recurrent state. Valid suffix starts at local index0 and only end padding follows. Padding still advances native state; it is not a frozen-state mask. Causality keeps earlier valid outputs unchanged, and the final cache from this one attribution continuation is discarded. No per-row B1 substitution or packed-FLA extension is needed for this design.
layout.finite_FA: Reuse captured original packed K/V and original owner padding/unpadding interfaces to build logical compact K/V with common stride K. Keep Q/U/output coefficients at physical stride S. Reuse original public varlen FA on captured original packed operands for LSE, replacing the existing auxiliary dense FA call rather than adding a new model rollout. Any rectangular LSE padding is representation-only and invalid tails are not consumed.
layout.finite_kernel: Extend the original finite owner, not a parallel copy: separate row logical query start p_i, Q/coefficient/LSE storage stride S and KV storage stride K. The original 3 phases, 64-tile scheduler, GQA mapping, GEMM operations, finite log-mean/center/P1 formulas remain. Grid is ceil(S/64) per original batch/head. Row logical tile starts p_i+block*64; Q pointer offset=(bh*S-p_i)*D; KV pointer offset=kv_bh*K*D. All tail writes and bounds must use local query storage extent S, not the old shared K-p_i. Merely changing scalar query_start to a vector would be incorrect.
layout.finite_other: Map head target positions and coefficient source positions to their row local positions, preserve zero upstream coefficients after valid suffix end, and scatter final signed effects to original row token positions. Pointwise finite MLP/norm/gate and original dense FLA finite formulas remain unchanged. Per-row initial prefix states and prefix KV are identical across each endpoint pair, so omitted prefix endpoint differences remain zero.

minimal_owner_change_sites.change: Optional per-row boundary metadata and source verification; compose original native cache tensors at each declared cut and pad only FA KV representation. Keep current scalar/default behavior untouched. Baseline exact sources are pinned in the prior API audit; local HEAD candidate files are not assumed deployed.

Optional row cut vector, local suffix/input/mask/position/target mapping; reuse one B4 native root and original layer replay, keep pairing and output scatter. Existing common min slice/scalar selection.suffix and all1-mask contract cannot express this as-is.

Reuse already observed original varlen packed tensors, cu lengths and original call args; select that owner call only for the opt-in layout. Do not replace original FA implementation or reproduce its unpad scheduler.

Logical compact KV operand representation plus row query-start/independent-stride ABI and original-kernel indexing extension. Preserve original finite arithmetic; no attention matrix, copied kernel or alternate scheduler.

classification.DT_credit_algorithm: Unchanged; no new Q/V/A, reward distribution, baseline, observation routing or policy loss.
classification.native_FA_FLA_algorithm: Unchanged original operators. FA switches via existing original mask->varlen path; GDN stays original dense recurrence with per-row supplied initial states.
classification.new_capability: A genuine optional per-row cached-suffix layout and finite-FA ABI/indexing capability inside existing owners. It must be described as an owner extension, not as already-supported official configuration.

cost_and_limits: Additional prefix-boundary states may enlarge capture/bank cost; current row-storage representation can retain only consumed row states, but this design is not a new measured bank result.
KV unpad/repad, mask/index metadata, capture retention and public varlen LSE introduce or shift copy/allocation/kernel costs. Their net runtime and memory cost have not been measured.
All genuine historical KV reads are still required. Suffix slot reductions do not directly equal attention FLOP or wall-clock reductions; dense B4 still pads to the longest valid suffix.

The saved vendor varlen source has rectangular public LSE at566. The exact installed current wrapper return shape/stride was not newly sampled in this audit; current-owner receipt compatibility must not be inferred from the saved C++ file alone.

Variable suffix lengths and native dense->varlen execution can change floating-point ordering and compiled shapes. This review contains no numerical acceptance, official-tolerance result or speed promise.

Boundary-zero initialization and short/single-token special paths were not exercised in this read-only review. Use existing native-owner semantics if implemented; do not invent new behavior or treat this note as a new production blocker.
Historical88-row metadata reduction27.43-31.01% is a workload-slot bound only. It is not the current complete-iteration workload or an end-to-end gain.
